content.title: Investigate flaky frontend e2e tests (parent-selector and copy-token)
content.description:
Discovered while isolating the backend shared-state flakiness (mqe0745gy7). After serializing the suite, two DISTINCT frontend tests still flake intermittently. Different root cause than the backend issue: frontend timing and interaction sensitivity, not backend shared-state concurrency.

1. phase3 Frontend Parent Selector 'changes an existing parent' (phase3-validation.spec.ts line 1287). Fails with page.waitForResponse Timeout 10000ms at line 1321 (waiting for parent search results). Passes in isolation but flakes in the full serial run, likely sensitive to accumulated data volume. By the time phase3 runs serially, over 100 issues exist in the shared store, which may slow the search response or clutter the UI.

2. phase4 Frontend Copy Token 'copy button changes to check icon after register' (phase4-validation.spec.ts line 748). Flakes on the clipboard and check-icon assertion. Likely clipboard API timing in headless mode. Passes in isolation.

Neither is caused by the workers 1 change in mqe0745gy7 (that change only affects scheduling, not test logic). They surface variably across runs.

Suggested options to triage: increase waitForResponse timeout or add retry on the parent-search wait; for the copy-token test, grant clipboard permissions or add a small wait before the check-icon assertion; consider resetting worktree data before heavy frontend describe blocks so data volume stays bounded.

content.content: Ideas-loop triage. Dedup: checked against all statuses — explicitly distinct from mqe0745gy7 (backend shared-state flakiness) and the Phase 1-3 e2e work; no existing issue covers parent-selector/copy-token flakiness. Unique. Routing: technical test-infra issue raised by webapp-developer (a worker, not a manager) — not manager-originated, so no auto-accept. Routed to the CTO (org technical lead) for a review decision. Created Review task mqe1im9n14 (assignee cto) + sync tracker mqe1imqlgf (blocked by the review). Idea set to in-progress so the work loop won't re-wake me. Awaiting decision — on accept I'll plan implementation children; on discard I'll close with idea,discarded.

Accepted per CTO review (mqe1im9n14) as a chore (test-hygiene; no product behavior change). Ideas-loop sync tracker mqe1imqlgf closed.

Implementation plan (single deliverable — both fixes are low-risk, test-only, same domain, so one chore rather than two):
• Dev mqe1uwxw8c (webapp-developer) — implement both fixes: stabilize parent-selector waitForResponse race (phase3) + grant clipboard permission / raise copy-token assertion timeout (phase4). The CTO's review already served as the root-cause diagnosis/plan, so no separate Plan task.
• Validate mqe1uwxa5q (webapp-validator) — blocked by Dev; run the full serial e2e suite repeatedly, confirm both tests are stable and no regressions.
• Sync mqe1uw075w — blocked by Validate; wakes me to verify and close.

Note: assigned Dev to webapp-developer (not the validator the CTO suggested) per assignment principles — validators validate, developers develop. The Dev task description carries the CTO's full fix recommendations.

Status loop: all children (review/triage, stabilization, validation, completion gate) are done. Top-level chore with no parent — closing and closing all descendants. Flaky parent-selector and copy-token e2e tests stabilized and validated.
